Vegetable

Bell Pepper

About This Entry

Bell pepper adds sweet capsicum crunch raw or roasted — ratatouille and fajitas favor fruity reds, rosé, and unoaked whites.

Wine Pairing Explanation

Primary wine styles

  • syrah shiraz

Alternative wine styles

  • grenache

Why These Wines Work

Syrah Shiraz — Roast bell pepper pairs with Syrah in Provençal and Mediterranean vegetable platters.

Grenache also pairs well with Bell Pepper because sweet capsicum suits Grenache fruit in ratatouille and piperade contexts.

Bell Pepper — Bell pepper vegetal sweetness mirrors bell-pepper notes in Carmenère and cool-climate Syrah.
